evidence_location.quote: IFN ELISpot assays were performed on freshly isolated PBMC from all 24 subjects at screening and at 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination, using the Human IFN ELISpot(ALP) kit(Mabtech).
Exploratory predefined immunological analyses included multi-parameter flow cytometry as detailed below.
Anti-r85AIgG wasmeasuredinserumsamples collectedat week 0, 2, 4 and 24. ELISA plates (NUNC ImmunoPlates, Fisher) were coated overnight with2 g/ml r85A(Lionex, Germany)inPBS.
